FPU: No reachable instruction in either function uses FPU; core has no floating execution/state model, so this is static instruction exclusion, not simulated FPU validation.
peripheral_policy: No MMIO mapping provided; any peripheral access fails. Both tested leaf functions make zero calls.
limitations: Declared-entry only; arbitrary interior entries and other firmware consumers remain unproved.
Division scenarios are finite. Range enumerates all256 input bytes with8 prior flag seeds, not every architectural machine state.
Static CFG decoder rejects calls/indirect control/opaque instructions; it is not a whole-ROM reachability theorem.
RAM role mapping is a software correspondence, not a transmission physical-state/freshness claim.
